$comment: Advisories accepted for the apps/web dependency tree, consumed by scripts/ci/audit-gate.ts.
An entry here does NOT silence the advisory: the gate still prints it on every run.
It records a reviewed judgement that the advisory is not actionable today, and the date
on which that judgement stops being valid. Past reviewBy, the gate blocks again.
Only high and critical advisories are gated; moderate and low are reported only.
Rules: every entry states what was checked, not just a conclusion. No entry may be added
for an advisory whose vulnerable code path is reachable in production.
Policy and triage procedure: docs/SECURITY.md section 6.

advisories.reason: No fixed version exists: braces 3.0.3 is the latest release and the advisory covers <=3.0.3 (checked with `npm view braces version` on 2026-10-12). `npm ls braces` shows one copy, reached only through micromatch <- fast-glob, pulled in by two devDependencies: the shadcn CLI and @next/eslint-plugin-next (via eslint-config-next). Neither is imported by app, lib or components code (grep for shadcn, fast-glob and micromatch imports found none), so braces is not in the production bundle or any request path. The flaw is stack exhaustion on a deeply nested brace pattern; the only patterns that reach braces here are glob strings written in this repo's own lint config and in commands a developer types, never request or user data. Worst case is a crashed local or CI lint/CLI process. Revisit when braces or micromatch ships a fix, or drop the shadcn devDependency in favour of `npx shadcn`.
